messages:
alex: FYI — support escalated: acme-inc reporting p99 latency spikes on hosted/us-west ~11:10 PDT. Correlates with a burst of prefix-cache misses right after an autoscale event.
sara: saw the alert. p95 ~1200ms, p99 ~3500ms on /v1/generate for redwood-moderate. Can we get cache-miss graphs?
mike: pulling metrics ->
```
prefix_cache.miss_rate{cluster=\"us-west\",model=\"redwood-moderate\"} 0.78
prefix_cache.evictions/sec 42
prefix_cache.size 1.2GB
```
sara: eviction/sec is pretty high after the scale. smells like thrash: warmup TTL too short + key churn from slightly different prompts.
mike: quick repro idea: same intent but vary trailing whitespace/punctuation — we might be hashing raw prompt strings (no normalization). That would create tons of unique keys.
alex: can you paste the hashing snippet?
mike:```
# bug: hashing raw prompt + session id
key = sha256(prompt + session_id)
# missing normalization: strip/collapse whitespace, normalize newlines, unify punctuation
```
jenn: I reverted the recent key-change on staging earlier. I'll promote a hotfix that normalizes prompts before hashing to prod in ~2m.
deploy-bot: deploy started by jenn — hotfix/prefix-key-normalize -> prod (rolling)
alex: mitigation while rolling: support can enable a temporary warmup for acme-inc routes and bump warmup_ttl to 10m; also switch eviction_policy -> lru-size to avoid size-agnostic thrash. @sara can ops apply?
sara: applying now. CLI I used: 
```
redwoodctl routes update --customer acme-inc --warmup-ttl 600 --eviction-policy lru-size
```
sara: changes applied to the customer route. Also added metric prefix_cache.normalized_keys to validate the new path.
mike: repro command for support to validate after hotfix: 
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"Hello\\n\\n","model":"redwood-moderate"}'
# then run same request with extra spaces/punctuation — should map to same normalized key after hotfix
```
jenn: deploy finished. prod instances reporting prefix_cache.normalized_keys=true in logs.
alex: early telemetry: miss_rate dropped 0.78 -> 0.12 within ~3m after fix; p99 back to ~420ms. Keeping on-call watch for 1h.
support-bot: notified acme-inc (ticket #12345): we applied warmup and hotfix; asked them to repro their traffic pattern and share logs if issue persists.
alex: thanks — please capture postmortem notes. Runbook additions: always normalize cache keys, add staging validation of key entropy, e2e test for whitespace/punctuation churn.
mike: will open PR for unit + perf tests.
jenn: follow-ups: mike (tests), sara (runbook), alex (postmortem).
alex: ack. :thumbsup:
